# Close sprint

> Closes a Gradatim project's open sprint, with what is left deferred, its critical changes shown again, and the main documents brought in line. Use when the user asks for Gradatim's close sprint step, or to close, end or wrap up a sprint.

| | |
|---|---|
| Skill | `close-sprint`, [its file](../../skills/close-sprint/SKILL.md) |
| Step | 11 of 14: close sprint |
| Runs | When the sprint's work is done |
| Next | release when there is something to ship; else review when it is due; else new sprint |
| Call it | `/gradatim:close-sprint` on Claude Code; [the other hosts](install.md#calling-a-skill) |

## When to use it

- The user asks for Gradatim's close sprint step, or to close, end or wrap up the open sprint.
- Not for a built task's close: that is [`close-task`](close-task.md). Not for a closed task's pull request: that is [`draft-pr`](draft-pr.md). Not for a new task, or the next sprint: that is [`new-sprint`](new-sprint.md). Not for shipping: that is [`ship-release`](ship-release.md). Not for the review: that is [`review-project`](review-project.md). Not for a change of direction: that is [`decide-direction`](decide-direction.md). Not for a folder with no Gradatim project: that is [`init-project`](init-project.md).

## What it reads and writes

| Document | Path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Agent file | `AGENTS.md` | reads |
| Agent docs | `docs/agents/<topic>.md` | reads |
| Architecture | `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` | reads |
| Release record | `docs/RELEASES.md` | reads |
| MVP | `docs/MVP.md` | reads, changes |
| Roadmap | `docs/ROADMAP.md` | reads, changes |
| Phase | `docs/PHASE-<k>.md` | reads, changes |
| Sprint rules and index | `docs/sprints/README.md` | reads, changes |
| Sprint README | `docs/sprints/sprint-<n>/README.md` | reads, changes |
| Task file | `docs/sprints/sprint-<n>/<ID>-<slug>.md` | reads, changes |
| Design | `docs/plans/<ID>-<slug>-design.md` | reads |
| Issue | `docs/issues/YYYY-MM-DD-<ID>-<topic>.md` | reads, changes |
| Deferred item | `docs/deferred-items/YYYY-MM-DD-<origin>-<topic>.md` | reads, creates, changes |

It deletes an issue or a deferred item at its end, as the map says. It runs the project's gate, in the check, and writes none of the project's own files, and no `CLAUDE.md`. The map's other documents change only through [the sync](../../skills/method/references/sync.md), at the yes. It never changes a sealed document: one that differs from its seal is put back as it was sealed, at the user's word.
